skill.name: amazon-product-search-api-skill
skill.description: Collect Amazon search result data through BrowserAct using keywords, brand filters, result limits, and language settings.
skill.summary: Runs a BrowserAct workflow to collect structured Amazon product search data.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: Review found expected BrowserAct network calls and environment credential access, with many static findings caused by Markdown inline code. The main concerns are unsafe API key handoff guidance, local script execution, opaque remote workflow behavior, and claims about avoiding CAPTCHA or IP restrictions. No prompt injection attempt was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.suggestion: Remove instructions asking users to provide the key to the agent. Require BROWSERACT_API_KEY through local environment variables or a secret manager only.
Document the remote workflow behavior, data retention, and destination domains. Include a reviewable workflow definition when possible.
Remove claims about avoiding CAPTCHA or IP restrictions. Add guidance for Amazon terms, rate limits, and lawful data collection.
Require explicit user confirmation before running the Python script or retrying failed runs, especially when API usage may incur cost.
Move the timeout return into the polling loop failure path so finished tasks can retrieve output before publication.

content.value_statement: Amazon product research is slow when listings, ratings, and prices must be copied by hand. This skill runs a BrowserAct workflow to collect structured search results.
actual_capabilities: Starts a BrowserAct workflow template for Amazon product search tasks.
Accepts keywords, brand filter, result limit, and language settings.
Polls workflow status and prints timestamped progress logs.
Reads the BrowserAct API key from BROWSERACT_API_KEY.
Defines expected product fields such as title, URL, rating, price, delivery, and availability.
limitations: Requires a valid BrowserAct API key before any search can run.
Sends search terms and task metadata to BrowserAct as a third-party service.
The included script needs a control-flow fix before it can return final results.
Data availability depends on Amazon listings and the BrowserAct workflow response.

use_cases.title: Review competitive prices
use_cases.description: Collect product titles, ratings, review counts, and prices for a brand or category search.

use_cases.title: Build product catalogs
use_cases.description: Gather product URLs and listing details to support catalog planning and sourcing research.

use_cases.title: Check localized listings
use_cases.description: Search Amazon with a selected interface language to compare regional product presentation.

prompt_templates.title: Search one category
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to search Amazon for wireless earbuds from Sony. Limit the run to 20 results and use English.

prompt_templates.title: Compare a brand segment
prompt_templates.prompt: Collect Amazon search results for laptop stands from Rain Design. Include ratings, reviews, prices, and availability when present.

prompt_templates.title: Monitor localized listings
prompt_templates.prompt: Run an Amazon search for phone cases from Spigen in Japanese. Summarize product titles, prices, and delivery details.

prompt_templates.title: Build a research dataset
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to collect up to 100 Amazon results for robot vacuum from iRobot. Group findings by price, rating, and best-seller status.

output_examples.input: Search for Sony wireless earbuds with a limit of 20 results.
output_examples.output: A product summary with titles, Amazon links, star ratings, review counts, prices, and availability when the workflow provides them.

output_examples.input: Compare Samsung phone listings in English.
output_examples.output: A concise comparison of matching products, including current prices, list prices, delivery details, and best-seller indicators.

output_examples.input: Find laptop stand listings from a specific brand.
output_examples.output: A filtered result set that highlights product names, URLs, ratings, review counts, and shipping information.

best_practices: Set BROWSERACT_API_KEY in the local environment instead of pasting it into chat.
Use narrow keywords and brand filters to reduce irrelevant results and API cost.
Confirm data collection permissions, marketplace terms, and rate limits before running searches.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into prompts, shared terminals, or saved transcripts.
Do not run broad searches with high limits before reviewing cost and compliance.
Do not treat monthly sales estimates or best-seller labels as exact business facts.

faq.question: Does this skill require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires BROWSERACT_API_KEY so the script can call the BrowserAct workflow API.

faq.question: Does it run a local browser?
faq.answer: No. The local script calls BrowserAct, which runs a remote workflow template.

faq.question: Which inputs can I control?
faq.answer: You can provide search keywords, a brand filter, a maximum result count, and a language value.

faq.question: What product data can it collect?
faq.answer: Expected fields include title, URL, rating, review count, price, delivery information, and availability.

faq.question: Is the API key shown in output?
faq.answer: The script does not print the key value, but users should still store it in the environment only.

faq.question: Is it production ready?
faq.answer: Not without review. The script needs a result retrieval fix and clear compliance guidance before production use.
